summary: KKR FS Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting a routine unregistered sale of equity securities under Item 3.02 and an update on its ongoing continuous private offering under Item 8.01. On May 21, 2026, it issued 206,091.447 Class I shares at $29.23 per share (NAV) for ~$6.024 million, relying on Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D accredited-investor exemptions. The trust also disclosed aggregate net asset value of $1.582 billion as of April 30, 2026, and that its continuous offering remains open for up to $5.0 billion. No special-situation event exists; this is a standard capital raise for a BDC.
